paths.commander: The core is pure (doc 13 §1): the CLI framework belongs in src/commands/ or src/cli.ts, not src/core/.
paths.execa: The core is pure (doc 13 §1): subprocess calls live in an adapter (e.g. the backlog-cli adapter), never in src/core/.
paths.omelette: The core is pure (doc 13 §1): the completion library belongs in the command/adapter layer, not src/core/.
paths.node:fs: The core is pure (doc 13 §1): file-system effects go through the injected FileSystem port and its node-fs adapter, never node:fs in src/core/.
paths.node:fs/promises: The core is pure (doc 13 §1): file-system effects go through the injected FileSystem port and its node-fs adapter, never node:fs/promises in src/core/.
paths.node:os: The core is pure (doc 13 §1): platform/OS access goes through the injected Environment port, never node:os in src/core/.
paths.node:child_process: The core is pure (doc 13 §1): subprocess execution lives in an adapter, never node:child_process in src/core/.
